manifest.description: Diagnose Rust error types, Result signatures, and conversion paths that have become accidental architecture boundaries.
when_to_use: an error enum is not actionable for callers or exposes the wrong layer
one broad error type hides ownership drift across modules
a correction plan may use rust-error-migrate and public API guard
anti_patterns: do not assert ?-site conversion without compiler validation
do not use for rustc conversion errors without an architectural contract claim
do not grant acknowledge_public_api_change on the operator's behalf
